purpose: Review official Basti/UP cadastral service discovery and bounded anonymous API behavior.
assessment: Basti district and UP Board of Revenue sources establish an official local/state revenue-map route. The current BhuNaksha JavaScript configuration was followed to its public API. Hierarchy and map extent requests worked anonymously; safe plot metadata worked for bounded plot-number lookups; full polygon retrieval was held because the current geometry endpoint required an Authorization header. No polygon is retained.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official Basti district service page and official UP BhuNaksha service. This is evidence of revenue/cadastral service custody only, not title, ownership, or citywide parcel availability.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Basti district and UP BhuNaksha service; bounded test of Basti tehsil and village 181394.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Hierarchy, map extent, CRS, and safe plot metadata only; no anonymous full parcel polygon.

attempts: Fetched the official BhuNaksha viewer and inspected the current JavaScript configuration; no login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, or TLS exception was used.
Queried level 1, 2, and 3 hierarchy endpoints anonymously; Basti district=185, Basti tehsil=00939, tested village=181394 (अइलहा).
Queried getVVVVExtentGeoref for 18500939181394; received EPSG:32644 extent.
Queried getPlotAtXY with the exact WUP point [26.8009241721327,82.7436691752189] in latitude/longitude order; response was {} for the tested village and was not interpreted as absence.
Queried plot numbers 1, 2, and 10; responses contained safe ids, kide values, and bounding boxes, but no full geometry.
Queried v1/khasramap/plot with the safe id from plot 1; endpoint returned 401 Missing or invalid Authorization header. No token was sought or used.

geometryEvidence.exactWupPointTest: Tested only against the bounded village context; empty response is not evidence of citywide absence.

uncertainty: The current public geometry route may require a viewer session or authorization bootstrap.

Citywide and countrywide parcel coverage remain unknown.
